review_method: Source inspection and official reference documentation; no runtime or performance certification.
effort_note: Relative scope, not duration estimates. Includes semantics, settings, persistence, interaction, and tests; split large items into vertical slices.
sequence_note: Within a phase, respect dependencies. The first behavior slice is C03/C04; C05 is the small new visual; C07 is the first new broad chart family.

items.title: Expose Histogram and Distribution presets
items.current_state: Numeric histogram is inside Bar Chart. Violin and beeswarm settings exist inside Box Plot.
items.desired_outcome: Users find the capability by the analytical name they expect without duplicate renderers.
acceptance_criteria: Histogram is a discoverable creation option for numeric fields.
Distribution presents box, violin overlay, and observation-overlay options.
Existing saved type identifiers remain compatible.
Defaults produce useful plots without requiring all settings to be filled.

items.title: Make Other inspectable and selection-safe
items.current_state: Row chart creates a height-dependent Other categories bucket and disables its selection.
items.desired_outcome: High-cardinality data remains explorable instead of being hidden behind a terminal bucket.
acceptance_criteria: Other opens an explicit member list or drill view.
Member categories can be selected.
A selection is tied to category membership, not the label Other.
Resizing does not silently change the membership of a committed filter.
Active categories remain visible or clearly represented when outside the displayed top set.

items.title: Unify basic grouped metrics and source provenance
items.current_state: Named grouped results support one group field and count/sum/average; pivot has richer reducers.
items.desired_outcome: The same metric has the same meaning in bars, cards, tables, and future heatmaps.
acceptance_criteria: Count, sum, and mean agree across the first consumers.
Define row count versus valid-value count and behavior when there are no valid values.
Separate complete group membership from included numeric contributors.
Support zero, one, and eventually two grouping keys through incremental adapters.
Keep existing saved configurations readable; avoid a big-bang rewrite.

items.title: Make grouped bars participate in linked filtering
items.current_state: Aggregate bar click opens contributor inspection instead of a filter.
items.desired_outcome: Revenue by region filters the workspace as naturally as count by region.
acceptance_criteria: A mark can select its source group.
An explicit separate action retains value/contributor inspection.
Selecting and clearing groups updates all linked views correctly.
Invalid metric contributors do not disappear from group membership without an explicit rule.
Keyboard selection and restored selection match pointer behavior.

items.title: Add basic metric cards
items.current_state: Filtered-row status exists but no registered arbitrary metric-card type.
items.desired_outcome: The selected population has a visible count and metric summary.
acceptance_criteria: Count, sum, and mean are available through shared reducers.
Units and formatting use field metadata.
Population scope is named.
Empty/invalid and zero results are visually distinct.
Inspect action explains contributors without changing selection.

items.title: Generalize metric bars across orientations and series
items.current_state: Horizontal chart is count-oriented; bar settings lack first-class grouped/stacked series.
items.desired_outcome: A category/metric/series configuration can change presentation without losing analysis state.
acceptance_criteria: Horizontal and vertical bars accept the same metric.
Grouped and additive stacked modes share categories, colors, and source membership.
100% stacks state the normalization denominator.
Negative and nonadditive metrics are rejected or handled explicitly.
Metric sort and explicit Top N coexist with stable selections.

items.title: Add categorical heatmap with exact cell inspection
items.current_state: Pivot exists; no heatmap is registered.
items.desired_outcome: Two categorical dimensions can be compared visually using a shared metric.
acceptance_criteria: Two grouping fields and one metric drive cells.
Zero, absent group, and invalid metric results differ.
Color domain and legend have explicit semantics.
Single-cell selection maps to the corresponding raw group.
Cell inspection reports exact value and contributors.
Keyboard access, ordering, and high-cardinality overflow are defined.

items.title: Add tuple-aware selection for nonrectangular multicell choices
items.current_state: Current filter types are field-based values/ranges/text/date-ranges.
items.desired_outcome: Selecting two region/channel pairs selects exactly those pairs.
acceptance_criteria: (North, Web) OR (South, Retail) excludes the two unselected cross combinations.
Interactions within one selection and intersections across views are specified.
Selection survives serialization and data replacement according to a documented rule.
Facet membership is included when the intended selection is local to a facet.
Visual filtering and record inspection use the identical predicate.

items.title: Add long-form series and calendar aggregation
items.current_state: Line connects values from multiple measure columns and uses numeric axes, not calendar rollups.
items.desired_outcome: Raw orders/events become date-bucketed series without external reshaping.
acceptance_criteria: Date field, interval, metric, and optional categorical series field are first-class.
Day/week/month boundaries and time-zone policy are explicit.
Duplicate timestamps are aggregated in rollup mode; raw-observation mode remains available.
Missing periods have metric-appropriate, explicit zero/gap behavior.
Calendar-aware ticks and brush bounds agree with the source interval.
Series values match an independent grouping of the same source rows.

items.title: Add area and stacked-area presentations
items.current_state: Line rendering includes paths and points, not filled/stacked area modes.
items.desired_outcome: Time series can show totals and composition through shared grouped data.
acceptance_criteria: Line and area use identical metric results.
Stack ordering, missing buckets, and negative-value behavior are explicit.
Changing mode preserves group identity and filter state.
A rolling window, when added, identifies its size and missing-value policy.

items.title: Clarify filter scope and inline legend behavior
items.current_state: Standalone legend filters; line legend is static. Table/Rows search and filtering have different scopes.
items.desired_outcome: Users can distinguish visual hiding, local search, and global filtering.
acceptance_criteria: Line legend supports hide/isolate with visible state.
Hiding a series is not silently treated as filtering source rows.
Global/local scope is labeled where controls are used.
Promoting a local predicate to the workspace is an explicit action when supported.
Standalone categorical/date filter controls reuse existing predicates.

items.title: Add reference rules, intervals, and annotations
items.current_state: BaseChart offers an overlay slot but shared saved settings have no annotation model.
items.desired_outcome: Existing charts express targets, events, and supplied bounds without custom renderer forks.
acceptance_criteria: Fixed horizontal/vertical rule with label works first.
Fixed, whole-population, and selected-population reference scopes are distinguished.
Bands and supplied lower/upper bounds are persisted.
Labels do not cover essential marks at supported desktop sizes.
No inferential confidence claim is made for an unlabeled input interval.

items.title: Add size encoding and identifiable scatter observations
items.current_state: Scatter has uniform pointSize, color, Canvas, brush, and a coordinate readout.
items.desired_outcome: Users recognize large/unusual entities and inspect them directly.
acceptance_criteria: A size field maps nonnegative values to proportional area.
Size legend and missing/negative policies are explicit.
Identity and chosen fields appear in an inspectable tooltip.
Pointer and non-pointer inspection paths exist.
Brushing still resolves to original observations.

items.title: Add binned density mode
items.current_state: Inspected scatter implementation has no density mode.
items.desired_outcome: Overlapping observations become readable without losing raw-row filtering.
acceptance_criteria: Rectangular 2D bins are a valid first implementation.
Bin boundaries and color quantity are explicit.
Selections resolve to raw observations using documented boundary inclusion.
Binning for display does not silently sample away selected records.
Filtering, hover, and redraw are benchmarked on named workloads.

items.title: Add correlation matrix to scatter exploration
items.current_state: No correlation-matrix family is registered; scatter requires choosing a pair directly.
items.desired_outcome: Users discover relationships across several numeric fields and immediately inspect a pair.
acceptance_criteria: Method, population, and valid-pair count are visible.
Constant and insufficient-data fields produce unavailable results, not zero correlation.
Missing-value policy is explicit and tested.
Cell activation opens the corresponding scatter configuration rather than inventing a record filter.
Large field lists have a bounded, usable selection workflow.

items.title: Add ECDF and comparable distributions
items.current_state: Histogram and box/violin/beeswarm are present; no cumulative distribution family is registered.
items.desired_outcome: Users answer threshold/percentile questions and compare groups without export.
acceptance_criteria: ECDF reports fraction of valid observations at or below a value.
Ties, invalid values, and empty selections are tested.
Comparison histograms share bin edges.
Count versus within-group percentage is explicit.
Baseline scope is named and persists as configured.

items.title: Introduce selection-only undo and redo
items.current_state: Clear-all, removable filter chips, precise ranges, and brush clearing exist; recommendation extends these.
items.desired_outcome: Exploration is reversible without requiring universal application undo.
acceptance_criteria: One completed gesture creates one history step.
Undo/redo restores complete filter state across linked views.
Clear-all itself can be undone.
Data replacement resets or rebases history by an explicit policy.
History is bounded; no raw dataset copies per brush update.

items.title: Add named baseline/selection comparison
items.current_state: Existing shared filters and saved settings provide a starting point, not a complete comparison feature.
items.desired_outcome: Users compare the current population with a precisely defined reference selection.
acceptance_criteria: All data, pre-selection population, and saved predicate are different named choices.
Raw snapshot versus reevaluated predicate behavior is explicit on data changes.
Comparison marks use compatible scales and metric definitions.
Population count and valid-value denominator are available.
Cards, distributions, and references consume the same scope definition.

items.title: Complete axis-domain controls
items.current_state: Numeric-scale helper/UI implement linear and symlog; calendar-specific support is separate work.
items.desired_outcome: Users can control view domains without accidentally changing record selection.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit bounds and reset/lock behavior are specified.
A true logarithmic option explicitly handles nonpositive values.
Zoom and filter actions are distinguishable.
Brush pixels invert to raw numeric values correctly under every supported scale.
Saved settings restore domains and selection consistently.

items.title: Optional geographic views
items.current_state: No geographic chart is registered.
items.desired_outcome: Geographic users see spatial patterns without expanding the core into a mapping platform.
acceptance_criteria: Prioritize only with evidence of geographic user workflows.
Start with points or caller-supplied GeoJSON and explicit record joins.
Unknown/unmatched regions are reported.
Selections map to source records consistently.
Projection/data/basemap requirements are documented; avoid implied geocoding support.

items.title: Familiar composition and contribution presets
items.current_state: No pie/donut or waterfall family is registered.
items.desired_outcome: Close recognizable presentation gaps after the main analytical contracts are complete.
acceptance_criteria: Donut uses a bounded set of nonnegative categories with readable labels and totals.
Donut selection reuses category membership.
Waterfall has explicit start/end and subtotal semantics.
No new reducer implementation is hidden in the renderer.
